name: The Fate of the Den
label: Quest
description: The Fate of the Den: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It would appear that there is a correspondent hiding somewhere in Valanaar feeding information to the cult. I am clearly in no shape to make the journey, but Lotheluum needs to know what transpired here.
He should also know the fate of those who are no longer with us. Thanks to your help I think we can handle the rest of the situation from here, though the damage has been done.
Please go swiftly, friend. I hope our paths will cross again someday. Until then, I have cultists to slay.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Lotheluum wears a look of genuine terror as you recount the events from the druid den.
I--I'm sorry, friend. I need just a moment. There are no words I possess that can describe the loss.

This is grave news indeed. If this missive is not fabricated, then we indeed have at best an accomplice and at worst a traitor here in Valanaar. I will take this to the High Elder immediately! I will not let my fellows' sacrifice be in vain.

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
